title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder, Solid Brass Countertop Stand, 6-Inch Height - | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder crafted from solid brass, designed for easy countertop placement when wall space is limited.

  • Solid brass construction: Built for enduring daily bathroom use
  • Weighted base: Helps prevent tipping on the vanity or counter
  • Space-saving design: Keeps a roll within reach without wall mounting
  • Surface protection: Felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Dimensions: 5.5-Inch length x 5-Inch width x 6-Inch height
  • Weight: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Works well with modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures.
